(* TreeFold.treehash_fold_correct *)
lemma treehash_fold_correct:
  forall (pk : Bytes.bytes) (c0 : BArray24.t) (N : int -> int -> Bytes.bytes)
    (na : FIPS205_Address.adrs) (base t : int),
    (forall (x0 : BArray48.t) (a0 : BArray32.t),
       phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._thash_h :
                in_0 = x0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                BArray24.to_list res.`1 =
                FIPS205_Hash.H SetModel.P pk (ADRS.bytes_of a0)
                  (BArray48.to_list x0)] = (Real.(%r) 1)) =>
    (forall (z j : int),
       0 Int.(<=) z Int.(<) t =>
       Int.(<=) 0 j =>
       N (Int.(+) z 1) j =
       FIPS205_Hash.H SetModel.P pk
         (FIPS205_Address.setTreeIndex
            (FIPS205_Address.setTreeHeight na (Int.(+) z 1))
            (Int.(+) (IntDiv.(%/) base (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 (Int.(+) z 1))) j))
         (List.(++) (N z (Int.( * ) 2 j)) (N z (Int.(+) (Int.( * ) 2 j) 1)))) =>
    0 Int.(<=) t Int.(<=) FIPS205_Params.a SetModel.P =>
    IntDiv.(%|) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 t) base =>
    forall (nd0 au0 : BArray216.t) (x0 : BArray24.t) (id0 ai0
      tg0 : JWord.W32.t) (na0 : BArray32.t),
      phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._treehash_fold :
               nodes = nd0 /\
               auth = au0 /\
               node = x0 /\
               idx = id0 /\
               adrs_idx = ai0 /\
               target = tg0 /\
               ctx = c0 /\
               node_adrs = na0 /\
               Int.(<) (JWord.W32.to_uint id0) (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 t) /\
               JWord.W32.to_uint ai0 = Int.(+) base (JWord.W32.to_uint id0) /\
               BArray24.to_list x0 = N 0 (JWord.W32.to_uint id0) /\
               List.take 24 (ADRS.bytes_of na0) = List.take 24 na /\
               TreeFold.fs N nd0 t (JWord.W32.to_uint id0) /\
               TreeFold.au N au0 t (JWord.W32.to_uint id0)
                 (JWord.W32.to_uint tg0) ==>
               TreeFold.fs N res.`1 t (Int.(+) (JWord.W32.to_uint id0) 1) /\
               TreeFold.au N res.`2 t (Int.(+) (JWord.W32.to_uint id0) 1)
                 (JWord.W32.to_uint tg0) /\
               List.take 24 (ADRS.bytes_of res.`4) = List.take 24 na] = (
      Real.(%r) 1).

(* ForsTree.fors_tree_correct *)
lemma fors_tree_correct:
  forall (pk_seed : Bytes.bytes) (c0 : BArray24.t),
    (forall (k0 : BArray24.t) (a0 : BArray128.t),
       phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._thash_prf_x4 :
                sk_seed = k0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                forall (k : int),
                  0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 =>
                  WotsLeaf.lanev (FIPS205_Params.n SetModel.P) k
                    (BArray96.to_list res.`1) =
                  FIPS205_Hash.PRF SetModel.P pk_seed (BArray24.to_list k0)
                    (WotsLeaf.lanev 32 k (BArray128.to_list a0))] = (
       Real.(%r) 1)) =>
    (forall (x0 : BArray96.t) (a0 : BArray128.t),
       phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._thash_f_x4 :
                x = x0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                forall (k : int),
                  0 Int.(<=) k Int.(<) 4 =>
                  WotsLeaf.lanev (FIPS205_Params.n SetModel.P) k
                    (BArray96.to_list res.`1) =
                  FIPS205_Hash.F SetModel.P pk_seed
                    (WotsLeaf.lanev 32 k (BArray128.to_list a0))
                    (WotsLeaf.lanev (FIPS205_Params.n SetModel.P) k
                       (BArray96.to_list x0))] = (Real.(%r) 1)) =>
    (forall (x0 : BArray48.t) (a0 : BArray32.t),
       phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._thash_h :
                in_0 = x0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                BArray24.to_list res.`1 =
                FIPS205_Hash.H SetModel.P pk_seed (ADRS.bytes_of a0)
                  (BArray48.to_list x0)] = (Real.(%r) 1)) =>
    forall (k0 : BArray24.t) (a0 : BArray32.t) (t0 tg0 : JWord.W32.t) (l tr y
      kp w1 w0 : int),
      ADRS.bytes_of a0 = FIPS205_Address_Props.mk_adrs l tr y kp w1 w0 =>
      0 Int.(<=) kp Int.(<) JWord.W32.modulus =>
      Int.(<) (JWord.W32.to_uint t0) (FIPS205_Params.k SetModel.P) =>
      Int.(<) (JWord.W32.to_uint tg0)
        (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 (FIPS205_Params.a SetModel.P)) =>
      phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._fors_tree :
               sk_seed = k0 /\
               ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 /\ tree = t0 /\ target = tg0 ==>
               BArray24.to_list res.`2 =
               ForsTree.fnode pk_seed (BArray24.to_list k0) l tr y kp
                 (JWord.W32.to_uint t0) (FIPS205_Params.a SetModel.P) 0 /\
               BArray216.to_list res.`1 =
               List.(++)
                 (FIPS205_TreeForms.fors_sk SetModel.P (BArray24.to_list k0)
                    pk_seed l tr kp
                    (Int.(+)
                       (Int.( * ) (JWord.W32.to_uint t0)
                          (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 (FIPS205_Params.a SetModel.P)))
                       (JWord.W32.to_uint tg0)))
                 (List.flatten
                    (List.map
                       (fun (z : int) =>
                          ForsTree.fnode pk_seed (BArray24.to_list k0) l tr y
                            kp (JWord.W32.to_uint t0) z
                            (MerkleTrees_FIPS205.gsibling
                               (IntDiv.(%/) (JWord.W32.to_uint tg0)
                                  (Ring.IntID.(^) 2 z))))
                       (List.Range.range 0 (FIPS205_Params.a SetModel.P))))] = (
      Real.(%r) 1).

                    (WotsLeaf.lanev (FIPS205_Params.n SetModel.P) k

                in_0 = x0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                BArray24.to_list res.`1 =
                FIPS205_Hash.H SetModel.P pk_seed (ADRS.bytes_of a0)
                  (BArray48.to_list x0)] = (Real.(%r) 1)) =>

       phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._thash_t_k :
                in_0 = m0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                BArray24.to_list res.`1 =
                FIPS205_Hash.T_l SetModel.P pk_seed (ADRS.bytes_of a0)
                  (BArray792.to_list m0)] = (Real.(%r) 1)) =>
    forall (s0 : BArray35664.t) (i0 : BArray132.t) (k0 : BArray24.t)
      (a0 : BArray32.t) (md : Bytes.bytes) (l tr y kp w1 w0 : int),
      ADRS.bytes_of a0 = FIPS205_Address_Props.mk_adrs l tr y kp w1 w0 =>
      0 Int.(<=) kp Int.(<) JWord.W32.modulus =>
      phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._fors_sign :
               sig = s0 /\
               indices = i0 /\
               sk_seed = k0 /\

               List.(++)

                       (BArray35664.to_list s0))
                    (FIPS205_FORS.fors_sign SetModel.P md
                       (BArray24.to_list k0) pk_seed (ADRS.bytes_of a0)))
                 (List.drop
                    (Int.(+) (FIPS205_Params.n SetModel.P)
                       (Int.( * ) (FIPS205_Params.k SetModel.P)
                          (Int.( * )
                             (Int.(+) (FIPS205_Params.a SetModel.P) 1)
                             (FIPS205_Params.n SetModel.P))))
                    (BArray35664.to_list s0)) /\
               BArray24.to_list res.`2 =
               FIPS205_FORS.fors_pkFromSig SetModel.P
                 (FIPS205_FORS.fors_sign SetModel.P md (BArray24.to_list k0)
                    pk_seed (ADRS.bytes_of a0)) md pk_seed (ADRS.bytes_of a0)] = (
      Real.(%r) 1).

                in_0 = x0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ adrs = a0 ==>
                BArray24.to_list res.`1 =
                FIPS205_Hash.H SetModel.P pk (ADRS.bytes_of a0)
                  (BArray48.to_list x0)] = (Real.(%r) 1)) =>
    forall (s0 : BArray28512.t) (m0 r0 : BArray24.t) (it0 : JWord.W64.t)
      (il0 : JWord.W32.t),
      phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._ht_verify :
               sig = s0 /\
               msg = m0 /\
               pk_root = r0 /\ ctx = c0 /\ idx_tree = it0 /\ idx_leaf = il0 ==>
               res.`1 =

                    (BArray24.to_list m0) (BArray28512.to_list s0) pk
                    (JWord.W64.to_uint it0) (JWord.W32.to_uint il0)
                    (BArray24.to_list r0) then JWord.W64.zero
               else JWord.W64.of_int (Int.([-]) 1)] = (Real.(%r) 1).

(* PreHash.prehash_ll *)

(* PreHash.prehash_h *)
lemma prehash_h:
  forall (s p0 l0 : JWord.W64.t) (mem0 : JMemory.global_mem_t),
    hoare[ CoreExtracted.M._prehash :
            sel = s /\
            msg = p0 /\
            msg_len = l0 /\
            JMemory.Glob.mem = mem0 /\
            1 Int.(<=) JWord.W64.to_uint s Int.(<=) 12 /\
            Int.(<=) (Int.(+) (JWord.W64.to_uint p0) (JWord.W64.to_uint l0))
              JModel_x86.ptr_modulus /\
            External.ph_dom (JWord.W64.to_uint s) p0 l0 ==>
            List.take (JWord.W64.to_uint res.`2) (BArray64.to_list res.`1) =
            FIPS205_External.ph_apply (External.ph_of (JWord.W64.to_uint s))
              (External.m_of mem0 p0 l0)
            ].

(* Thash.keccak_finalize_correct *)
lemma keccak_finalize_correct:
  (forall (s0 : BArray200.t),
     phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._keccakf1600 :
              st = s0 ==>
              KeccakState.lanes res.`1 =
              Keccakf1600_Spec.keccak_f1600_op (KeccakState.lanes s0)] = (
     Real.(%r) 1)) =>
  forall (s0 : BArray200.t) (p0 : JWord.W64.t) (m : JWord.W8.t List.list),
    phoare[ CoreExtracted.M._keccak_finalize :
             st = s0 /\
             pos = p0 /\
             rate = JWord.W64.of_int 136 /\
             ds = JWord.W64.of_int 31 /\
